# EDK II UEFI Shell

`shell.efi` is the unmodified x64 `Shell_Full.efi` from Arch Linux's
[`edk2-shell` package](https://archlinux.org/packages/extra/any/edk2-shell/)
version `202608-1`. The license is included.
